method: Walked /photography/explore at 390 and 1280 pixels and /photography/albums/Re7kho at 390 pixels on the dev server from the search-cutover branch (ADR 0006). The only change inside this surface's source roots is src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts, which swaps the query embedder from embedText to embedImageQuery and rewrites its comments; no component, layout or copy changed. Pages render with their grids (24 and 60 images), filters and header intact, and document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at every width. Semantic search results were not judged here: the new query path only returns meaningful results once migration 20260925240000 is applied, so result quality is verified against the live site immediately after cutover, not on this walk.
scope: chat route embedder swap (no rendered change)
search result quality deferred to live post-cutover check
